assertions.assertion: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and episodes of dizziness that are concerning for arrhythmia in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture continuous rhythm data and correlate these symptomatic events with potential cardiac dysrhythmias.
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0).
Mobile cardiac telemetry is coded as CPT 93229.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture continuous rhythm data.
The payer letter confirms the denial under reason code PR-204.
The payer letter confirms the denial of the claim for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229).
The denial reason code PR-204 indicates that the diagnostic procedure is not covered under the member's current benefit plan.
Coverage determinations are based strictly on the terms of the active policy, and this service falls outside those defined parameters.
The patient's documented symptoms and known mitral valve insufficiency support the medical necessity of this diagnostic procedure.
